title: IDL Dental Technologies to showcase implant solutions at GNYDM 2026
html:
Tue. 10. November 2026

share save

NEW YORK, US: IDL Dental Technologies, an Israeli manufacturer of dental implant systems and associated prosthetic products, will showcase its product portfolio at the exhibition accompanying the 2026 Greater New York Dental Meeting (GNYDM), taking place from 29 November to 1 December at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York. Dental professionals and industry representatives are invited to meet the company’s team at Booth 910.

Founded in 2008 and headquartered in Tel Aviv in Israel, IDL Dental Technologies develops and manufactures implant systems designed to address a range of clinical needs. Focusing on innovation, clinical versatility and practical solutions, the company continues to expand its international presence and strengthen relationships with dental professionals and distribution partners worldwide.

At GNYDM 2026, the company will present selected products and implant solutions from its portfolio, including:

  • Progressive and Core implant systems— solutions designed to achieve high primary stability and support immediate loading in suitable clinical cases;
  • zygomatic and pterygoid implants—specialised implant solutions for patients with severe maxillary atrophy and challenging anatomical conditions;
  • concave abutments—prosthetic components developed to support soft-tissue management and aesthetic outcomes; and
  • full-arch implant solutions—implants and prosthetic components for restoring edentulous arches.

Together, these products reflect the company’s approach to designing implant systems and prosthetic components to simplify surgical and restorative workflows. The portfolio includes solutions for immediate implant placement and complex rehabilitation cases.

Expanding international partnerships

As IDL Dental Technologies continues to develop its international distribution network, the company is seeking to connect with dental distributors, implant dentists, clinic owners and other industry professionals. At GNYDM 2026, dental professionals and clinic owners can learn more about the product portfolio and discuss clinical applications with the company’s team, while prospective distributors can explore partnership opportunities. Further information is available on the IDL Dental Technologies website.
